semantic_identity: Source-matched residential double-hung window with upper transom lights
intended_function: Replace the existing simple window asset appearance inside the authoritative reconstructed opening.

citizen_scale.ratio_or_view: 68-inch window height is 136 half-inch citizen-heights; compare against an exact dimension-derived schematic, not a generated person's apparent size.

silhouette_requirements: Complete wide, shallow window assembly within a 96 x 68 x 4 inch envelope.
Warm stained-oak casing with a fitted sill and jamb.
Two broad lower double-hung sash sections with a central vertical stile and meeting rail.
Narrow upper band divided into four transom lights.

construction_materials.construction: Fitted straight casing, side jambs and projecting sill; restrained household trim.
construction_materials.material: Warm dark stained oak with visible fine grain.

construction_materials.construction: Two aligned lower sash sections with slim center stile and horizontal meeting rail.
construction_materials.material: Stained oak and clear household glass.

construction_materials.construction: Four fixed upper lights with thin muntins and no decorative latch blocks.
construction_materials.material: Stained oak and clear household glass.

construction_materials.construction: One restrained centered latch at the lower meeting rail.

art_direction: Human Room: source-matched residential woodwork, clear glass and restrained reflections.
gameplay_distance_readability: The casing, central stile, meeting rail and transom band should read in the 64–330 inch room views.
source_photo_constraints: photo_holder/Sample (1).jpg shows dark warm wood casing, a divided upper transom band, two broad lower window sections, a center divider/meeting rail and clear outdoor glazing. Decorative corner blocks, repeated transom latches and the contents of the room are not window evidence.

visual_references.provenance: Room photo; only visible window features listed in source_photo_constraints are treated as evidence.
Actual Godot Compatibility render, review-only v002.
Selected/edited transom concept after pixel inspection.
Exact ArtBrief dimensions at 12 SVG pixels per inch; 0.5-inch citizen shown as a 6-pixel marker.

prohibited_failure_modes: No decorative corner rosettes or oversized stacked crown.
No repeated latches on fixed transom lights.
No opaque or strongly mirrored glazing.
No changes to RoomDefinition opening, dimensions, position, collision or navigation.
roomdefinition_authority: ArtBrief and rooms/room_photo_luna.json own the 96 x 68 x 4 inch opening, position and gameplay semantics. The 3D mesh is presentation only.
separate_room_assets: room objects visible through the glass
